'''2012 European Championship Peter Rowlands LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Rowlands]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif|label=We'll Handle This (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
